firm_name: Law Offices of Gary R. DeFilippo, PC

Firm's own site is a general litigator/criminal-defense presence with a personal blog (garydefilippo.blogspot.com); no dedicated solar page or case results despite having filed 10+ solar-lender cases - a striking gap given the real litigation track record, making this a strong 'hasn't invested in content yet' upsell candidate.

firm_name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid (TRLA) - Consumer Protection Team
contact_path: Central toll-free intake phone line only; nonprofit legal aid, no direct attorney email published
solar_evidence: TRLA's consumer protection team (manager Wayne Krause Yang) filed a counter-claim for an El Paso homeowner (Lorena Vargas) against Cross River Bank, Sunlight Financial LLC and Titan Asset Purchasing LLC, alleging a forged digital signature on a $100,000+ solar financing contract, seeking $250,000 in damages plus attorney's fees. Important intelligence (directly litigating against a target lender) but NOT a realistic paid-marketing prospect; flagging for awareness rather than sales outreach.
